name: Noida Metro Aqua Line extension (Sector 51 to Knowledge Park V)
description: 17.435 km with 11 elevated stations; Sector 61 is planned as the interchange with the Delhi Metro Blue Line. The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet approved the project report in November 2024. Central government approval and a construction start date could not be confirmed.
data_source: NMRC upcoming-projects page; Business Standard, 25 Nov 2024

name: Noida International Airport (Jewar) - Phase 1
description: One runway and one terminal with capacity for 12 million passengers a year. Phase 1 was inaugurated on 28 March 2026 and commercial flights began on 15 June 2026. The airport says international operations are planned; later phases have no published dates.
expected_completion: Phase 1 open since June 2026; later phases undated
data_source: Noida International Airport news release, 15 Jun 2026; Akashvani News, 27 Mar 2026

name: Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat (RRTS) corridor
locality: Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, Guldhar and Duhai stations
description: Regional rapid rail from Sarai Kale Khan (Delhi) to Modipuram (Meerut). The whole corridor has been in operation since 22 February 2026.
data_source: NCRTC official post, 23 Feb 2026; Wikipedia (Delhi-Meerut RRTS)

name: Gurugram Metro (Millennium City Centre to Cyber City loop)
locality: Old Gurugram and Dwarka Expressway sectors
description: 28.5 km with 27 elevated stations, approved by the Government of Haryana and the Government of India. The civil contract for Phase 1 (Millennium City Centre to Sector 9, about 15.2 km) was awarded in August 2025 and foundation work began in late 2025.
expected_completion: no official date on the GMRL project page
data_source: GMRL project page; India TV, 4 Aug 2025; Metro Rail Today

name: Dwarka Expressway (NH-248BB) - Haryana section
locality: Northern Gurugram sectors along the expressway
description: The 19 km Haryana section of the elevated urban expressway between Delhi and Gurugram was inaugurated on 11 March 2024.
